title: Make America Build Ships Again
summary: What are the implications of USTR for the tanker market? On March 28, we wrote a Tanker Opinion ( " It's Complicated " ) about the proposed actions of the Office of the United States Trade Representative ("USTR") to address China's alleged "dominance in the global maritime, logistics and shipbuilding sectors". Following a period of consultation and a two-day public hearing, the USTR published a revised notice on April 17, with actions that will be implemented in October 2025, after a 180-day grace period.
